hook.say: True or false? Five strange border facts, three seconds each. Wait until you hear number five!

outro.say: How many did you get? Comment your score!

questions.q: The border between the US and Canada is the world's longest.
questions.say: The border between the U.S. and Canada is the world's longest.
questions.fact: It runs 8,891 km, including the border with Alaska.
questions.sayAnswer: True! It runs 8891 kilometers, including the border with Alaska.

questions.q: Brazil borders every other country in South America.
questions.fact: Close! Brazil touches all of them except Chile and Ecuador.
questions.sayAnswer: False! Close! Brazil touches all of them except Chile and Ecuador.

questions.q: Mongolia shares a border with Kazakhstan.
questions.fact: Mongolia has only two neighbours: Russia and China.
questions.sayAnswer: False! Mongolia has only 2 neighbors, Russia and China.

questions.q: North Korea shares a border with Russia.
questions.fact: They meet along the Tumen River for about 17 km.
questions.sayAnswer: True! They meet along the Tumen River for about 17 kilometers.

questions.q: Canada shares a land border with Denmark.
questions.fact: In 2022 they split tiny Hans Island, between Canada and Greenland.
questions.sayAnswer: True! In 2022 they split tiny Hans Island, between Canada and Greenland.
